load_cfg_config_from_graph: load a CFG config from a JSON graph file using CFG_Config.from_graph
print_cfg_graph: print and visualize the CFG grammar rules using config.print_graph
generate_cfg_sequence_pure: generate a pure terminal symbol sequence from the CFG using generate_onedata_pure
generate_cfg_sequence_with_tree: generate a sequence with its full parsing tree using generate_onedata
verify_sequence_against_cfg: verify if a sequence satisfies the CFG and obtain a valid parsing tree using solve_dp_noneq_fast
